Description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP, recover Investiture equal to your Tier. You can sense living creatures within your Attunement Range that are below half their maximum HP.
Flavor Text: The Shepherd sees the flock thinning.

Description: Make a melee weapon attack. On a hit, deal [Tier][Die] + Willpower vital damage and the target cannot regain health until the start of your next turn.
Flavor Text: Where his hand passes, leaves curl black on the vine.

Description: Choose a Weakened character in Attunement Range and spend 2 Investiture to test Black vs. Spiritual. On success, the target becomes Afflicted[[Tier][Die] vital] and you regain health equal to half the damage dealt. One instance per character.
Flavor Text: Decay is patient. The host need only outlive its appetite.
Tags: death; vital_damage; afflicted; weakened; regenerate; investiture

Description: Spend 2 Investiture. For the scene, when a character drops to 0 health within your Attunement Range, each enemy within 10 ft of it takes [Tier][Die] spirit damage.
Flavor Text: Death is contagious.

Description: When a character dies within your Attunement Range, you recover 1 Investiture and mark the corpse as a Harvested Remain. You may sustain a number of Remains equal to your tier; unused Remains fade at the end of the scene. You sense each of your active Remains through any obstruction.
Flavor Text: Every fall is an offering. The world only asked for the courtesy of catching it.

Description: Spend a Harvested Remain on a 10 ft square in Attunement Range. For the scene, the square is difficult terrain, and a character that ends its turn in the square takes [Tier][Die] keen damage from grasping bone.
Flavor Text: He plants what others would bury.
Tags: death; difficult_terrain; keen_damage; harvest; area; investiture

Description: Touch a willing or Unconscious character. Remove one injury. The target falls into restful sleep for 1 minute or until damaged. On waking, it regains [Tier][Die] + Awareness HP.
Flavor Text: Some endings are kindnesses. He knows the difference.

Description: Spend a Harvested Remain — or touch any remains that died within the last 24 hours. Ask up to 3 questions; the spirit answers truthfully but briefly. Each additional use on the same remains within 24 hours costs an additional 2 Investiture.
Flavor Text: The dead remember. They simply have no reason to lie.

Description: Touch the remains of a character that died within the last hour, consuming a Harvested Remain if one represents the target. The character returns to life with 1 health and one additional injury. The raised character is Disoriented until the end of its next turn.
Flavor Text: The door is barred, not locked. He keeps a key.

Description: Choose a character in Attunement Range and spend 2 Investiture. If the target is unwilling, test Green vs. Spiritual; on a success (or freely on a willing target), the first time the target would drop to 0 HP this scene it instead drops to 1 HP and gains [Tier][Die] + Presence temporary HP. The effect then ends.
Flavor Text: Not yet. The gate remains shut.

Description: When you activate a Chaos talent, roll a d6. On 5-6, Investiture cost reduced by 1 (min 1). On 1, the effect also targets you or an ally (GM determines how). You sense sustained magical effects within Attunement Range.
Flavor Text: Chaos doesn't play favorites. That's the point.

Description: Target a creature in Attunement Range benefiting from a magical buff, stance, or sustained ability. Intellect test vs target's Spiritual Defense. On success, end one such effect; target takes Spirit damage equal to [Die].
Flavor Text: Every system has a thread. Pull it.

Description: Create a 15 ft radius zone at a point in Attunement Range. For the scene, no creature in the zone can benefit from Advantage, and all sustained magical effects in the zone cost +1 Investiture per turn to maintain.
Flavor Text: Order costs more than it's worth in here.

Description: When a creature in Attunement Range activates a talent, use Reaction to force a Willpower test vs your Cognitive Defense. On failure, the talent activates but targets a random valid target (including caster's allies).
Flavor Text: You meant to do that. You just didn't mean to do it to them.

Description: Choose a creature in Attunement Range. Its next test is altered: if the result is even, add [Die]; if odd, subtract [Die]. The creature is unaware until it manifests.
Flavor Text: Luck is just math you haven't seen yet.

Description: For the remainder of this round, when any creature in Attunement Range rolls a die, you may swap the result with the next die rolled by any creature in range. Usable a number of times equal to your Intellect modifier.
Flavor Text: The system is deterministic. I just changed the inputs.

Description: Once per round, when you fail a Cognitive test, reroll it (must accept new result). If the reroll also fails, gain Advantage on your next Physical test as your mind reroutes through instinct.
Flavor Text: Wrong answers are just right answers to different questions.

Prerequisites: Black Rank 3; Blue Rank 3; Chaos Attunement
Description: When a creature in Attunement Range makes a test, use Reaction to force a reroll. You choose which result is used. Cannot target the same creature more than once per scene.
Flavor Text: The Laughing Dark laughs because it already knows.

Description: Choose a point in Attunement Range. Every creature within 15 ft is teleported to a random unoccupied space within 30 ft. Teleported creatures are Disoriented (Disadvantage on next test). You may exclude yourself.
Flavor Text: Where you were isn't where you are.

Prerequisites: Black Rank 4; Blue Rank 4; Twist Fate
Description: Declare two different legal actions. Roll d6: on 1-3 the first occurs, on 4-6 the second. Whichever occurs has one attribute doubled (damage, healing, range, or duration — choose one). Occurs immediately.
Flavor Text: Both things are true until one of them happens.

Description: When you deal damage and reduce a creature below half max HP for the first time, gain 1 temporary HP per Tier. Gain Advantage on Presence tests to intimidate, command, or lead.
Flavor Text: Authority is not given. It is demonstrated.

Description: Choose a creature in Attunement Range. Presence test vs Cognitive Defense. On success, target is Compelled (must use next action to move toward you or do nothing) until start of your next turn.
Flavor Text: This is not a request.

Description: For the scene, whenever a creature in Attunement Range fails a test against your Cognitive Defense, it takes Spirit damage equal to your Presence. This damage cannot be reduced.
Flavor Text: Defy me. See what it costs.

Description: Choose a Compelled, Frightened, or Weakened creature in range. Willpower test vs your Spiritual Defense. On failure, you choose its next turn's action (cannot directly self-harm). On success, Weakened until end of its next turn.
Flavor Text: Your will was always borrowed. I'm taking it back.

Description: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP or score a critical hit, immediately move up to 15 ft and make a free melee attack against a different creature in reach. This attack deals bonus damage equal to Tier.
Flavor Text: The crown is taken in motion.

Description: For the scene, melee attacks deal additional damage equal to the number of creatures you've reduced to 0 HP this scene (max bonus = Tier x 2).
Flavor Text: Each one that falls makes the next fall faster.

Description: Until end of your next turn, you cannot be slowed, immobilized, or knocked prone. You may move through enemy spaces. Each enemy you move through takes Impact damage equal to [Die].
Flavor Text: Step aside or be a stepping stone.

Prerequisites: Black Rank 3; Red Rank 3; Will to Power
Description: Choose up to 3 allies in Attunement Range. Each gains temporary HP equal to [Die] and Advantage on next attack. You take Spirit damage equal to your Tier (cannot be reduced).
Flavor Text: A true leader bleeds first.

Prerequisites: Red Rank 4; Presence 4; Investiture of Command
Description: For the scene: +2 to all Defenses, melee attacks deal bonus Spirit damage equal to Tier, allies in Attunement Range gain +1 to all tests. When you take damage, may redirect up to Tier in damage to willing allies in range.
Flavor Text: The crown is not worn. It is become.

Prerequisites: Black Rank 4; Willpower 4; Investiture of Command
Description: Target a creature in range sustaining a magical effect. Willpower test vs its Spiritual Defense. On success, seize control of that effect for the scene — you choose targets, parameters, and when it ends. Original caster cannot end it.
Flavor Text: What was yours is mine. What was mine was always mine.

Description: At the start of each turn, choose one: one enemy in Attunement Range loses temporary HP equal to Tier, OR one ally in Attunement Range gains temporary HP equal to Tier. You are immune to disease.
Flavor Text: What grows must decay. What decays must nourish.

Description: Choose a 10 ft square in Attunement Range. Objects rapidly age. Creatures in area take Vital damage equal to [Die] at start of their turn. Persists 3 rounds. If a creature drops to 0 HP in area, an ally within 30 ft heals [Die] HP.
Flavor Text: The forest floor is built from the dead.

Description: When a creature in Attunement Range drops to 0 HP, harvest its essence. Gain +1 to a stat of your choice for the scene (max 3 harvests, each a different stat).
Flavor Text: The tree that falls feeds ten saplings.

Description: Choose a creature in Attunement Range. Its maximum HP is reduced by [Die] + Willpower until end of scene. If max HP falls below current HP, excess is lost immediately. Stacks up to twice.
Flavor Text: Even the strongest oak hollows from within.

Description: Declare a season for a 30 ft radius centered on you (scene): Spring (allies heal [Die] on Draw Mana), Summer (+1 Physical tests for allies), Autumn (-5 ft enemy movement), Winter (difficult terrain for enemies). Change season once/round as free action.
Flavor Text: The world turns because I say it turns.

Description: Choose two creatures in Attunement Range. Average their current HP totals (round down). Both are set to the new total. Cannot reduce below 1 HP or raise above maximum. One creature must be willing or unconscious.
Flavor Text: Nature demands balance. I enforce it.

Description: Choose up to 3 creatures in Attunement Range affected by Season's Mandate. For the scene, they cannot leave the area voluntarily. If forced out, must use next action to return.
Flavor Text: The forest does not release its own.

Prerequisites: Black Rank 3; White Rank 3; Cycle's Balance
Description: Extend senses through leyline network. For 1 minute, sense location and emotional state of every creature touching the ground within 120 ft. Learn locations of leyline nexuses within 1 mile.
Flavor Text: The roots carry everything. You only need to listen.

Prerequisites: Black Rank 4; White Rank 4; Tap the Root Network
Description: For the scene, at start of each turn, designate one creature in Attunement Range as 'in season' (heals [Die] HP) or 'out of season' (takes Vital damage equal to [Die]). You control the cycle.
Flavor Text: I am the Rootfather. I decide what grows.

Prerequisites: Awareness 4, Presence 3; Tap the Root Network
Description: Choose a point in Attunement Range. A leyline anchor manifests for the scene. Allies within 15 ft regain +1 Investiture on Draw Mana. Enemy leyline talents within 15 ft cost +1 Investiture.
Flavor Text: The roots grow deepest where I plant them.

Description: When you heal a creature, it gains temporary HP equal to Tier. You can sense current HP and Injury status of any creature within Attunement Range.
Flavor Text: She feels every heartbeat in the room. Every one of them is too loud.

Description: Touch a creature. Intellect test (DC 15). On success, heal [Die] x 2 and remove one condition (Weakened, Disoriented, or Slowed). On failure, heal [Die] only. May self-target.
Flavor Text: The body is a system. Systems can be repaired.

Description: Touch a creature with disease, poison, or parasitic effect. End all such effects. For the scene, the creature is immune to further applications of those specific effects.
Flavor Text: I've mapped the invader. It will not enter again.

Description: Choose a creature in Attunement Range. For the scene, know its exact HP, max HP, conditions, and Physical/Spiritual Defenses. You and allies attacking it deal bonus Vital damage equal to your Intellect.
Flavor Text: Now I see exactly where you're weakest.

Description: Choose a creature in Attunement Range. It regains [Die] + Awareness HP and grows natural armor (+1 Deflect until end of scene, stacks to 3). If at full HP, excess becomes temporary HP.
Flavor Text: The body doesn't just heal. It improves.

Description: Touch a willing creature. For the scene, at start of each turn it regains Tier + 1 HP. Regeneration ends if it takes Vital or Spirit damage. Also regrows missing limbs/organs over 1 hour.
Flavor Text: What was broken remembers what it was.

Description: When you heal a creature at full HP, excess erupts outward. Each creature within 10 ft heals half the excess. If no allies in range, target gains temporary HP equal to the full excess.
Flavor Text: There is too much life. It has to go somewhere.

Prerequisites: Blue Rank 3; Green Rank 3; Pulse of Life
Description: Touch a willing creature. Its max HP increases by [Die] for the scene. It gains +1 Strength and +1 Speed until end of scene. When effect ends, creature is Fatigued (Disadvantage on Physical tests, 1 minute).
Flavor Text: The Overflowing reaches through you. Can your body hold it?

Description: Touch a willing creature (may be self). For scene: regenerate [Die] HP per turn, immune to disease and poison, natural attacks deal bonus Energy damage equal to Tier. When effect ends, target takes an Injury.
Flavor Text: You are the vessel. The river flows through you now.

Description: Choose a creature in Attunement Range. For the scene, when it takes damage, you may take up to half instead (Spirit damage, bypasses Deflect). When you take damage this way, target heals HP equal to Tier.
Flavor Text: I will carry your weight. That is what the river does.

Description: Identify structural weakness of any object/construct in Attunement Range (1 round study or touch). Attacks vs objects deal double damage. When you damage a creature, learn its Deflect value.
Flavor Text: Everything falls. I simply know where to push.

Description: Choose a creature in Attunement Range you've damaged this scene. Your next attack ignores Deflect and deals bonus Keen damage equal to Intellect.
Flavor Text: There. That's the load-bearing wall.

Description: When you damage a creature and reduce it past an HP threshold (full, 3/4, 1/2, 1/4), its Deflect is permanently reduced by 1 for the scene. Stacks.
Flavor Text: One crack becomes two. Two becomes collapse.

Description: Place a Charge on an object, character, or 5 ft square in Attunement Range. Declare its trigger when you place it (default: start of your next turn). You may detonate any of your Charges manually as a Free Action on your turn. When a Charge detonates, each character within 10 ft takes [Tier][Die] energy damage and the detonation point becomes dangerous terrain (a character that enters or starts its turn in one of those squares takes [Tier] energy damage)for the scene.
Flavor Text: I don't destroy everything. Just the part that matters.

Description: Melee or ranged attack. On hit, deal normal damage plus bonus Energy damage equal to [Die]. Target pushed 10 ft. If target collides with object or creature, both take Impact damage equal to Tier.
Flavor Text: The rubble will tell the story.

Description: Choose a point in Attunement Range. 20 ft radius explosion deals Energy damage equal to [Die] x 2. Creatures failing a Speed test are knocked prone. Objects under 20 HP are destroyed.
Flavor Text: Nothing personal. Just physics.

Description: For the scene, spaces you move through become difficult terrain. Creatures starting turns in your trail take Impact damage equal to Tier. You gain +10 ft movement speed.
Flavor Text: The road behind me doesn't exist anymore.

Prerequisites: Blue Rank 3; Red Rank 3; Ruin Sight
Description: Choose a 15 ft area in Attunement Range. Selectively destroy chosen objects/terrain/barriers while leaving others untouched. Chosen creatures take Energy damage equal to [Die]. Excluded creatures are unharmed.
Flavor Text: Destruction is not chaos. Destruction is surgery.

Prerequisites: Blue Rank 4; Red Rank 4; Controlled Demolition
Description: For the scene, once per turn when you destroy an object/barrier or reduce a creature to 0 HP, choose: an ally within 30 ft heals [Die] HP, OR create 10 ft of clear stable ground (removing hazards/terrain).
Flavor Text: What I tear down, the world rebuilds. That was always the purpose.

Description: 60 ft line, 5 ft wide from you. Creatures in line take Energy damage equal to [Die] + Strength, Speed test or fall prone. Line becomes difficult terrain for the scene. Structures along line take triple damage.
Flavor Text: The earth remembers where Razkael walked.

Description: Sense lies spoken within Attunement Range (feel dissonance, don't learn truth). Creatures that break a promise or oath in range are Marked (you know their location for 1 hour).
Flavor Text: The Covenant Keeper remembers every word.

Description: Choose a creature in Attunement Range. Declare a prohibited action. Willpower test vs your Cognitive Defense. On failure, the prohibited action costs 2 Focus. Lasts until scene end or creature succeeds Willpower test at start of its turn.
Flavor Text: The clause is entered into the record.

Description: When a creature violates a Binding Clause or breaks a witnessed oath, it takes Spirit damage equal to [Die] x 2 and is Stunned until end of its next turn. Triggers automatically, no Reaction needed.
Flavor Text: The court finds you in contempt.

Description: When you successfully apply Binding Clause, apply the same clause to one additional creature in range as free action (same test required). Your Binding Clauses cannot be dispelled by non-deity magic.
Flavor Text: The ruling applies broadly.

Description: Choose up to 3 allies in Attunement Range. For the scene, when you Assist one, all designated creatures gain the benefit. Designated creatures gain +1 to tests when adjacent to another designated creature.
Flavor Text: Structure is strength. Alone, you are a person. Together, you are an institution.

Description: For the scene, allies in Attunement Range that can see you gain +1 to all Defenses. Bonus increases to +2 if also affected by Chain of Command.
Flavor Text: The institution protects its own.

Description: When an ally in Attunement Range would fail a Cognitive test, use Reaction: it uses your Willpower modifier instead. Usable Presence times per scene.
Flavor Text: Your discipline is my discipline. The chain holds.

Prerequisites: Blue Rank 3; White Rank 3; Lawkeeper's Eye
Description: You and a willing creature in touch range swear a Sacred Oath (defined at casting). For the scene, both gain +1 to all tests while pursuing the oath's goal. Acting against the oath deals [Die] x 2 Spirit damage and ends it.
Flavor Text: Speak the words. Mean them. The Covenant is listening.

Prerequisites: Blue Rank 4; White Rank 4; Sacred Oath
Description: Choose a creature in range that has broken an oath, lied to you, or violated a declared law. For the scene: Disadvantage on all tests, -2 Defenses, cannot benefit from magical healing. Ends if creature publicly confesses and accepts your penalty.
Flavor Text: The court has reached its verdict.

Description: Upgrade an existing Sacred Oath. Both oath-sworn share telepathic link, can spend each other's Investiture (with permission). When one drops to 0 HP, the other takes a free turn. Cannot be broken except by mutual consent.
Flavor Text: This bond will outlast us both.

Description: The first time each scene you attempt something you've never done before (GM discretion), gain Advantage. You can sense when a creature or object in Attunement Range is concealing information.
Flavor Text: The Ember Sage lit the first fire by asking 'what if I touch it?'

Description: After observing a creature for 1 round, learn one (your choice): highest stat, most damaging attack, or one vulnerability/resistance. Each subsequent round reveals an additional fact.
Flavor Text: Watch long enough and everything tells you what it is.

Description: After using Pattern Recognition on a creature, for the scene: you and allies in Attunement Range gain +1 to attacks vs that creature. First hit each round deals bonus damage equal to Awareness.
Flavor Text: I've classified you. Now I can unmake you.

Description: Sense ecological history of current location. Learn: creatures that passed through in last 24 hours, environmental hazards within 120 ft, hidden passages/traps/buried objects within 60 ft.
Flavor Text: The land remembers everything. You just have to speak its language.

Description: Declare a hypothesis about a creature/situation. Act to test it. If correct, Advantage on all related tests for the scene. If wrong, take [Die] damage but learn the correct answer.
Flavor Text: Wrong answers teach faster than right ones.

Description: When you fail a test, gain cumulative +1 to that type of test for the scene (max +3). Bonus resets on success.
Flavor Text: Failure is data. I collect a lot of data.

Description: Once per scene, on a critical hit or critical success: regain 2 Investiture, Advantage on next two tests, and learn one secret about the target or situation (GM provides significant hidden information).
Flavor Text: THAT'S what it does. I knew it. I KNEW it.

Prerequisites: Green Rank 3; Red Rank 3; Seeker's Flame
Description: Share something learned through Pattern Recognition, Reckless Experiment, or similar. Up to 3 allies in Attunement Range gain the same knowledge and associated mechanical benefits for the scene.
Flavor Text: Listen. I figured it out. And now so have you.

Description: For the scene, whenever you or an ally in Attunement Range learns new information (talents, tests, observation), all allies in range heal 1 HP and gain +1 to next test.
Flavor Text: Every answer is a flame. The Ember Sage burns brightest in a room full of questions.

Description: Ask the GM one question about the current scene, encounter, or creature. The GM must answer truthfully and completely. You take Spirit damage equal to [Die] (cannot be reduced or prevented). Knowledge is permanent.
Flavor Text: Some things cost. I'm paying.

Description: At the start of each scene, the GM privately tells you one true statement about what will happen during this scene (vague but accurate). You cannot be Surprised.
Flavor Text: The threads are fraying. But they still tell stories.

Description: Choose a creature in Attunement Range. Glimpse its immediate future: know what action it intends next turn. Gain +2 to Defenses against that creature until end of your next turn.
Flavor Text: I saw this coming. I always see it coming.

Description: After you or an ally in Attunement Range makes a test (before GM announces result), declare success. Costs 1 Focus in addition to Investiture. Once per scene.
Flavor Text: That was always going to happen.

Description: When hit by a creature you've used Read the Threads on, spend 1 Investiture to reduce damage by [Die] + Awareness. If reduced to 0, move 5 ft without provoking.
Flavor Text: I was never standing there.

Description: Declare a prediction about the scene. If it comes true, all allies who heard it gain Advantage on next test and heal Tier HP. If it fails, you lose 1 Focus.
Flavor Text: I have spoken. The threads will comply.

Description: Designate up to 4 specific spaces in Attunement Range. Allies in those positions gain +1 to all Defenses and +1 to attack tests. Lasts for scene or until ally moves away.
Flavor Text: Stand here. Not there. Here. Trust the pattern.

Description: Choose an ally in Attunement Range. Next time it takes damage this scene, reduce by [Die] + Presence. If source was predicted by Thread Sight, reduce by additional [Die].
Flavor Text: I saw this blow before it was thrown. It was never going to land.

Prerequisites: Green Rank 3; White Rank 3; Thread Sight
Description: Choose two willing creatures in Attunement Range. Fates linked for scene: when one takes damage, other may take up to half instead. When one is healed, other heals half the amount.
Flavor Text: Your threads are intertwined now. What happens to one happens to both.

Prerequisites: Green Rank 4; White Rank 4; Weave the Thread
Description: Once this scene, after any die roll by any creature in Attunement Range, replace the result with any value from 1 to die maximum. The roller is unaware fate intervened.
Flavor Text: The Loom was broken. I'm mending it by hand.

Description: Choose a creature in Attunement Range. Declare one thing that WILL happen to it this scene. The first time it could naturally occur, it automatically succeeds (no test). Wasted if it never naturally occurs.
Flavor Text: I didn't make it happen. I simply ensured it would.

Description: Repair mundane objects by touch (1 min per repair). Deal double damage to structures/constructs. Allies in Attunement Range gain +1 HP when completing a short rest.
Flavor Text: The Hearthwright builds in the rain because the city needs walls by morning.

Description: Touch an object, weapon, or armor — fully repaired. If on creature wearing damaged armor, Deflect restored to max. Alternatively, create a temporary weapon/tool from materials (1 hour, standard weapon of choice).
Flavor Text: Hand me that. I'll have it fixed before the next wave.

Description: Create a temporary fortification in 10 ft area within touch range: barricade, wall, or bridge. HP equal to [Die] x 3 + Strength x 2, provides full cover. Lasts for scene.
Flavor Text: I don't need a quarry. I need ten minutes and something to be angry about.

Description: Touch a weapon (yours or ally's). For scene, deals bonus Energy damage equal to Tier and counts as magical. Crits deal additional [Die] Energy.
Flavor Text: The forge-fire burns hot enough when the builder cares enough.

Description: 15 ft radius area in Attunement Range. For scene, allies gain +1 Physical Defense. Enemies treat area as difficult terrain. Area visually marked (glowing foundation lines).
Flavor Text: This ground is claimed. This ground is held.

Description: Fortified Position enhanced: objects/structures in area have double HP. Ranged attacks targeting creatures in area have Disadvantage. Physical Defense bonus increases to +2.
Flavor Text: Let them come. The walls will hold.

Description: While in Fortified Position, allies that Draw Mana regain +1 Investiture. Allies using Recover action regain additional HP equal to your Presence.
Flavor Text: A city with good infrastructure makes everything easier.

Prerequisites: Red Rank 3; White Rank 3; Builder's Oath
Description: Create a Hearthfire at a point in touch range. For scene, allies within 15 ft gain +1 to Willpower tests. Adjacent allies may spend 1 Action to regain [Die] HP. Extinguished by 10+ Energy damage.
Flavor Text: Come to the fire. The city starts here.

Description: For scene, allies in Attunement Range are 'citizens.' Citizens use Help at 30 ft range. When a citizen drops to 0 HP, all others gain Tier temporary HP and Advantage on next test.
Flavor Text: We are more than individuals. We are a city.

Description: Establish a route between two points in Attunement Range (max 60 ft apart). For scene, allies teleport between points as free action once per turn. Items passed instantaneously.
Flavor Text: Civilization is connection. The road matters more than the wall.

Description: Spend a Harvested Remain to raise its corpse as a Risen Servant in the corpse's space for the scene. The servant has health equal to [Tier][Die] + your tier, deflect 1, Speed 25 ft, defenses equal to yours minus 2, and one melee attack per turn dealing [Tier][Die] keen damage. It is immune to fear, disease, and influence, and acts immediately after your turn.
Flavor: Rise. The work was not finished.
Tags: death; summon; harvest; keen_damage; buff; investiture
